podcast.body: Issued just seven months after *A Love Trilogy*, this was a full-blown concept album, composed of a suite of six to eight-minute tracks, each named for a season, such as "Winter Melody" to "Spring Affair." Tracks from this album also reached number one on Billboard's Club Play chart, cementing Summer's status as disco's emerging queen. It went gold within weeks, but, like its predecessor, did not produce a top 40 pop hit. "four seasons of love was a full-blown concept album, composed of a suite of six to eight-minute tracks named for the seasons, from Winter Melody to Spring Affair."
